Farming herbs and ores, is a pain because of all the bots in the game. I change layers and still run into them. I have been farming in EPL for the past 4 hours and I gotten over 215 Honor kills off of bots. I reported all of them too. You can tell they are bots, because they will rez in front of me without attacking me. They will rez and eat right away. Hunter pets won’t even attack me. It’s mainly hunters, mages and some priests. How am i supposed make gold if I am barely getting any mats to make anything unless you spend 10+ hours farming for a couple of stacks of mats everyday.

No I don’t want to play retail. I have played retail for 17 years and I dislike it at this point. Classic is my drug and the people I have met are awesome.
